doc: The first-match tutorial (scripts/match/tutorial.gd). steps: [id, the one banner line]. detail: a plain-words second line under it (%X the E ability in words, %R the rank-up keys, %N the E ability's name, %U the ultimate's level, %F interact). %W swing or shoot, %J jump, %G glide, %E the E key, %T the Boki key, %s the Boki's name, %A an ability's name; the step's key shows as a key cap beside the line. alt: the line for a variant of a step (the right click with a hold, the Boki starting out). labels: the marker's caption per step. mob: how the tutorial's monsters differ from real ones (hp and size up, damage and attack tempo down). need: how many times a step's action must land, shown as 1/3 on the pill.
steps: Steer to land on the meadow
Jump, then dash in the air
Climb up and hold to crouch
Tap to send %s at the monster
Open the chest with the key

detail.gkey: G is your Boki button. Tap it to send %s at a foe, tap again to call it back. Hold it for orders.
detail.rank: Each level gives a skill point (the gold + by your level). Press %R to rank up %N. Your ultimate opens at level %U.
detail.key: Chests are locked. Walk over the key to pick it up.
detail.chest: A chest needs a key. Hold %F beside it to open it; that uses the key.
detail.uplink: Stay inside the circle until it's yours. Step out and the capture slips back!
detail.defend: Stay inside the circle. Step out and the capture slips back!

alt.throw_send: Tap again to send %s at the monster
